messages:
maria: Quick design question — in the Vectors preview the Export CTA is primary in the top-right and keyboard users keep triggering it when tabbing through the toolbar. Screenshot: https://staging.redwood.dev/pts/vec-preview-qa.png

maria: Can we: 1) add a skip link to jump straight to the results table, 2) move Export into a More menu (so it's not a primary action), and 3) ensure SR announces when export starts/finishes?

jonathan: +1. Accidentally downloading/export triggering is a real UX footgun. Moving Export into a menu makes sense. Also suggest explicit aria-label on the export trigger: `aria-label="Export vectors (opens dialog)"`.

anya: For skip links: add an offscreen focusable link that becomes visible on keyboard focus — label it `Skip to vectors table`. VoiceOver picks up offscreen links fine if the text is descriptive. Also ensure the table has `role=table` and a `tabindex=0` region for SR to land on.

kevin: Quick keyboard-order suggestion: current tab order is filters > Export > density > rows. Proposed order: filters > density > rows > more menu. That should reduce accidental Export activation.

samira: Small copy nit for the modal: use `Download CSV` instead of `Export CSV` — clearer for non-product folks. Also add a `role=status` region in the modal to announce progress updates like `Preparing download (45%)`.

tyler: Dev note — backend already supports streaming export, can add SSE updates that the frontend consumes and forwards to `aria-live`/status region. I'll also emit an `export.started` analytic event.

design-bot: Deploy preview: https://staging.redwood.dev/vectors-preview?skipLink=true — added a focusable skip link and moved Export into the overflow menu. @maria please smoke test with VoiceOver and NVDA. :rocket:

maria: Verified on mac VoiceOver. Skip link appears but the label reads just `Skip` — change to `Skip to vectors table` per @anya. After change, VoiceOver reads it correctly and focus lands on the table header. Tab stops are reduced by one. :thumbsup:

jonathan: Can we also make the skip link visible enough? Need a 3px solid focus ring in dark mode — it's easy to miss in the dense toolbar.

kevin: I'll update the focus style and adjust tab index. Also will add `aria-label="Export vectors — opens modal"` on the overflow item and ensure the overflow menu is reachable by keyboard (aria-haspopup, aria-expanded).

samira: I'll add a Cypress e2e that tabs through the toolbar, asserts the skip link appears on focus, and verifies the table receives focus. We'll also run axe checks for the download modal state.

maria: Copy updates to Figma and the content checklist: 1) Skip text = `Skip to vectors table`, 2) Export menu item label = `Download CSV` (and subtext `Includes selected rows`), 3) Export button state = disabled with `aria-disabled` while processing, 4) progress announced via `aria-live=polite` region.

tyler: Sounds good — I'll wire SSE + aria-live polyfill for browsers without native support. Plan to ship in patch 0.21.3.

jonathan: One last nit — when export completes and file is ready, SRs should get a short confirmation like `Download ready`. Use `role=alert` briefly so it interrupts screen readers.

kevin: Noted — will emit a `export.complete` event and toggle the alert for 2s.

maria: Great work team. If no objections I'll mark this done and add the a11y checklist to the PR description. Thanks!

samira: Adding tests now.

design-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4287 — includes skip link, menu reorder, aria updates.

maria: Closing thread — follow-ups tracked in the PR.
